package.name: kontrolem_workbench
package.description: Kontrol'Em v2 offline design workbench (M18): the `kontrolem_setup` CLI a control engineer uses BEFORE the robot moves. Discovers the installed control laws through the M16 pluginlib registry (list/describe), validates and scaffolds deployment YAMLs against each law's ParameterSpec (lint/new), and analyzes a configured law offline: closed-loop test-signal simulation with time-domain metrics for every law, plus law-specific analysis panes (eigenvalues, interpolation gaps, imposed-dynamics predictions). The engine is the same ROS-free core the runtime deploys, so what you analyze is byte-identical to what runs.
